title: Training army intelligence officers in remote viewing

tellings.quote: well the reason i stopped was i was already working uh frankly 24 hours a day on on training the army intelligence officers

plain: A researcher named Hal Puthoff, described in a podcast title as a CIA UFO expert, says he once stopped other work because he was busy almost around the clock training US Army intelligence officers. The training was in remote viewing, the practice of trying to perceive distant places or things using only the mind. If true, it would mean the army took such abilities seriously enough to teach them.
